event_name: Time 17:56 2018 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 8 - 11 November 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 31 & 32) and heard the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and of Appendix H, Article 2.4.5.1 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: A time penalty of 5 seconds is imposed after the race (5 seconds added to elapsed race time). (2 penalty points awarded, 3 points for the 12 month period).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and heard from the driver of car 2 (Stoffel Vandoorne), the driver of car 8 (Romain Grosjean) and the team representatives. The Stewards determined that car 2, Stoffel Vandoorne failed to let car 8 by at the first opportunity, although shown the blue flags for a significant number of corners. The Stewards acknowledged that Car 2 was racing with Car 18 at the time, but considered that this issue has been discussed at previous drivers' meetings and consistent with previous cases impose a 5 second time penalty and 2 penalty points.
stewards: Stoffel Vandoorne failed to let car 8 by at the first opportunity
but considered that this issue has been discussed at previous drivers' meetings
consistent with previous cases impose a 5 second time penalty
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 38 2018 Brazilian Grand Prix Offence Car 2 Ignoring Blue Flags
